rows.text:
To our friend from the outside, [Trailblazer]:

Do come and make friends with the fairies, mem!
Everyone here is warm and welcoming.
Remember, only children with pure hearts
can ever find the path to the Maze.

I've included some little gifts with this letter.
Hope you have a wonderful time in the Maze, mem!

Spoken by Dolimem, penned by Relimem
